name: WhatsApp
description: Chat with Mercury on WhatsApp and talk to it by voice call. Mercury runs on a spare number as a linked device (unofficial protocol).
author: Cosmic Stack

tools.name: call_owner
tools.description: Ring the owner on WhatsApp and talk to them by voice (only the owner can be called; rate-limited). Use for things that matter right now; send a message for everything else.

owner.description: Your own WhatsApp number. Only this number can talk to Mercury.
owner.label: Which number will you chat from?

access.label: What can Mercury do in your chat?
access.description: You can change this anytime in /plugins whatsapp.

optionLabels.general: General: chat and general knowledge only. No tools, files or personal memory.
optionLabels.extended: Extended: memory, files, tools and actions. Anything risky still asks you first.

members.description: Other numbers allowed to chat with Mercury, comma separated (they can't run admin commands).
members.label: Other numbers allowed to chat

memberAccess.description: What members may do (never more than you).
memberAccess.label: What can those numbers do?

allowGroups.description: Answer in WhatsApp groups (owner and members only).
allowGroups.label: Answer in WhatsApp groups

answerCalls.description: Answer voice calls from the owner.
answerCalls.label: Answer your voice calls

maxCallsPerHour.description: Most times Mercury may call you in an hour.
maxCallsPerHour.label: Most calls from Mercury per hour

maxCallMinutes.description: Longest a call can last, in minutes.
maxCallMinutes.label: Longest call, in minutes
